node.title: Re: Checking for blank string
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Himaja],

Could you show us your hash with [mod://Data::Dumper]? E.g. use Data::Dumper; print Dumper(\%hash);

You check for definedness with [doc://defined], e.g. if (!defined $hash{key}). One way to check for an empty string is with [doc://length], e.g. if (!length $hash{key}), but make sure to check [doc://defined] first, because length(undef) will also be false (and before Perl v5.12, will throw a warning).

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
